claims.text: Adapted large language models demonstrate capability to match or exceed human expert performance in specific medical text summarization tasks.
Only 7% of medical text summarization studies conducted external validation.
Only 3% of medical text summarization studies performed patient safety assessments.
Hallucination rates in medical text summarization using LLMs range from 1.47% to 61.6%.
Existing reporting guidelines do not adequately address the specific requirements of medical text summarization tasks.
The final MEDAI-LLM-SUMM checklist comprises 24 items organized into six sections.
MEDAI-LLM-SUMM uniquely addresses hallucination assessment requirements compared to existing reporting standards.
MEDAI-LLM-SUMM uniquely addresses reference summary creation methodology compared to existing reporting standards.
MEDAI-LLM-SUMM uniquely addresses LLM-as-judge validation protocols compared to existing reporting standards.
MEDAI-LLM-SUMM uniquely addresses detailed pilot testing specifications compared to existing reporting standards.
